ai.enhanceNotifDesc: When to use: enable this when the gateway fires alerts frequently and you want a quick root-cause summary and remediation direction. How to use: once enabled, every circuit-breaker, retry-exhausted, WAF-block, proxy-error, or rate-limit alert is followed by an AI-generated analysis notification with likely cause and suggested actions.
ai.enhanceNotifExampleText: Likely cause: downstream order-api has reached the failure threshold. Suggested action: check the target service health and confirm whether it is a transient network issue; if recovered, you may reset the circuit breaker manually.
ai.mcpServerDesc: When to use: turn this on when you want external AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, Coze) to query gateway state automatically. How to use: enable it and set a port, then paste the URL below into your external tool; it can discover tools via server/discover and call tools/call.
ai.testFailed: Connection failed. Please check API Key and Base URL
ai.testNoKey: Please configure API Key before testing
ai.useCacheHint: Cache repeated requests to reduce cost and latency
ai.fallbackDesc: Auto-switch to fallback provider when primary is unavailable
